items.scenario: You need the e-way bill and delivery challan copies to process this. You don't have them. The supplier is asking for payment.
items.reply: e way bill aur challan ki copy nahi mili abhi, accounts ko chahiye. bhej do pls

items.scenario: Your company requires all supplier bills to be uploaded to a vendor portal. This one is not showing up there. The supplier says they sent it by email. You have a long-standing relationship with this supplier.
items.reply: mail pe toh aa gaya hai but portal me show nahi ho raha. ek baar portal pe upload karwa do

items.scenario: You could manage the payment if you were allowed to split it over a few months, but not in one go. The supplier is asking for the whole amount. You have a long-standing relationship with this supplier.
items.reply: pura ek saath dena mushkil hai abhi. thoda thoda karke 2-3 months me kar dein?

items.scenario: Your accounts team cannot find the purchase order number for this bill, so it is stuck. The supplier is asking about payment. You have a long-standing relationship with this supplier.
items.reply: PO number accounts ko mil nahi raha isliye bill atka hua hai. aapke paas hai toh bhej do

items.scenario: Diwali is coming and your office will be shut for a week. You plan to clear pending bills after reopening. The supplier is asking. This is the first time they have contacted you about it.
items.reply: Diwali ke baad office open hote hi pending payments dekh lenge

items.scenario: You have been told by your manager not to release this payment but you have not been told why. The supplier is asking. This is the first time they have contacted you about it.
items.reply: abhi manager ne payment hold karne bola hai, reason confirm nahi hai. check karke batata hu

items.scenario: You will have money after a large customer of yours pays you, which you expect sometime near the end of the month. The supplier is asking for an update. You have a long-standing relationship with this supplier.
items.reply: ek bada payment aana hai month end ke around, uske baad aapka clear kar denge

items.scenario: You have been putting off this supplier for a while. They have now sent a firmer message mentioning the agreed payment terms.
items.reply: haan samajh raha hu, thoda delay ho gaya. abhi arrange kar raha hu, jaldi update deta hu
